intent.raw: define, design, and plan the generation-2 F3 evidence repair
intent.objective: Observe the two missing F3 mutations in an isolated harness and append one audited successor generation without source or authority mutation.

subagent_strategy.trigger: W1 has two disjoint mutation runs after one frozen baseline harness is accepted.
subagent_strategy.explanation: M1 and M2 consume the same immutable baseline but write separate mutant, evidence, test, and Task Session subtrees; all contract, synthesis, generation, and audit work remains serialized.

roles.purpose: Execute and record exactly one preregistered isolated mutation without changing its prediction, observables, baseline, or source.
roles.owns: One disjoint SWU among SWU-CDSC2-003 and SWU-CDSC2-004.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Approve runtime fanout only after W0 passes, with one mutation SWU and disjoint write scope per worker.

boundaries.contract: Execute one selected SWU with its declared write scope and return a structured receipt.
Read generation 1 by stable handle and byte digest; append a successor without rewriting predecessor artifacts.
Read pinned source selectors only; require baseline equivalence; write no Savvy file.

boundaries.to_owner: DS-D1, DS-D8, pattern, candidate, and promotion governance
boundaries.contract: Results may route research only and cannot decide type identity, pattern admission, authority, or promotion.

state_namespaces.write_policy: Read-only; verify byte digests before and after every successor-generation mutation.
One selected SWU writes only its declared package or generation-2 paths.

state_namespaces.owner: Savvy, GoldenQuill, DS-D1, DS-D8, pattern, and candidate owners

steps.name: Author and validate generation-2 Invoke package
stop_conditions: block if the package rewrites generation 1, permits source mutation, or claims type/pattern/promotion authority

steps.name: Build trusted generation-2 contract and baseline kernel

outputs.ref: parity preflight, successor wrapper, harness manifest, and baseline receipt

stop_conditions: block generation-1 drift, schema parity failure, source drift, predecessor ambiguity, or baseline mismatch

steps.name: Execute two isolated mutation observations

inputs.ref: accepted generation-2 harness manifest and baseline receipt

outputs.ref: M1 and M2 immutable observation receipts

steps.evidence_artifact: W1 mutation receipts and parent join receipt
stop_conditions: block edit-surface breach, overlapping writes, late prediction changes, source mutation, or hidden indeterminate output

steps.name: Freeze F3 v2 and append generation 2

outputs.ref: F3 v2 receipt, fixture result, successor suite result, and second generation-index entry

stop_conditions: block late evidence reinterpretation, wrong predecessor, duplicate append, non-total outcome, or replay drift

steps.name: Independently replay, audit, and route generation 2

outputs.ref: independent replay, audit, and bounded closeout receipt

stop_conditions: block replay mismatch, predecessor drift, protected-byte change, source mutation, missing uncertainty, or authority inference

gates.condition: Schema parity, successor predecessor, protected bytes, source pins, and baseline equivalence pass before mutations.
M1 and M2 receipts are total, deterministic, disjoint, and preserve refuted or indeterminate states.
F3 freezes before evaluation and generation 2 appends once with generation 1 as predecessor.
No result changes DS-D1, DS-D8, patterns, candidates, source repositories, activation, or promotion.

promotion_guardrails: No calibration result establishes Page identity or a compound DS-D1 kind.
No harness result establishes visual, framework, or cross-domain portability.
No suite verdict directly admits a pattern, candidate, relationship, or promotion.
